name: CCCS ITSG-33 (GC IT Security Risk Management)
description: IT Security Risk Management: A Lifecycle Approach — the Government of Canada catalogue of security controls (aligned to NIST SP 800-53) used to build departmental security control profiles.
scope: Government of Canada departments and agencies, and contractors handling GC information systems

families.name: Security Governance & Risk Management
families.description: Departmental security control profiles, risk management, and continuous monitoring

controls.name: Security Control Profile
controls.description: Select and tailor a security control profile appropriate to the information system's categorization (confidentiality, integrity, availability).

controls.name: Security Assessment & Authorization
controls.description: Assess controls and formally authorize the system to operate (ATO) based on residual risk acceptance by a delegated authority.

controls.name: Continuous Monitoring
controls.description: Maintain ongoing awareness of security posture through continuous monitoring of controls, vulnerabilities, and threats.

controls.name: Account Management
controls.description: Manage system accounts including establishment, activation, modification, review, disabling, and removal with least privilege.

controls.name: Multi-Factor Authentication
controls.description: Uniquely identify and authenticate users; enforce multi-factor authentication for privileged and remote access.

families.name: System & Communications Protection
families.description: Cryptography, boundary protection, and approved algorithms

controls.name: Approved Cryptography (CMVP)
controls.description: Use CCCS-approved cryptographic algorithms and CMVP-validated modules for protecting information in transit and at rest.

controls.name: Boundary Protection
controls.description: Monitor and control communications at external and key internal boundaries using managed interfaces and segmentation.

controls.name: Audit Event Logging
controls.description: Determine, generate, and retain audit records for security-relevant events sufficient to support after-the-fact investigation.

families.name: Incident Response
families.description: Handling and reporting of security incidents

controls.name: Incident Handling & GC Reporting
controls.description: Implement an incident handling capability and report cyber security events to CCCS and the appropriate GC authorities.
